paragraphs.text: Have you ever seen a fox in a city? In London, foxes are now a common sight. At night, they search dustbins for food and sleep in quiet gardens during the day. Scientists say that city foxes are smaller and braver than wild ones.

Why have so many foxes moved into cities? The main reason is easy food. People throw away a lot of food every day, and foxes quickly learn where to find it. Also, cities are warmer than the countryside in winter, which helps foxes survive the cold. Some people enjoy watching these clever animals, while others complain that foxes make their gardens dirty. Experts advise people not to feed foxes, because food from humans makes them lose their fear and cause more trouble.
